falsified_identification: The Schur correction of X_T(k,p)=p^{-(k+3/4)-iT} cannot equal the Euler prime Green term.
reasons: Schur corrections are quadratic while the Euler cross-resolvent is linear in von Mangoldt source weights.
The lowest diagonal exponent is p^-3/2 rather than p^-1/2-y.
The kernel uses primes only while the Euler trace requires every prime power.
Quadratic off-diagonal entries carry product weights and log-ratio phases.
surviving_role: The semigroup kernel remains a full-rank Hilbert-Schmidt comparison transform, not the linear Euler source leg.
open_target: Construct a self-adjoint two-boundary-channel Weyl/resolvent matrix with the exact linear Euler cross entry and gamma-renormalized diagonal covariances.
status: first Schur identification falsified; paired cross-resolvent architecture survives
